Who we are

Think of us as your marketing team.

Whether you're looking to grow your online sales or generate more qualified leads, we're here to help.

Our philosophy — Every business is different, so we don't believe in one-size-fits-all marketing. Before recommending any strategy, we take the time to understand your business, your customers, your goals, and the challenges holding your growth back.

Our credibility — Our team brings together 25+ years of combined experience and has worked with more than 30 brands across multiple industries. Having worked with leading agencies and well-known companies, we've learned what works — and just as importantly, what doesn't.

Our promise — our focus is simply to make smarter decisions, execute consistently, and deliver results that help your business grow.

How an engagement runs

Same four steps, every channel.

We run every channel through the same operating rhythm, so a Meta lead and an Amazon listing get judged by the same standard: is it moving the number that matters.

01

Audit

Full account, catalog and tracking review — where spend is leaking and where signal is missing.

02

Architect

Rebuild account structure, feeds and tracking around the 90-day target, not the existing setup.

03

Launch

Ship the new structure and creative in controlled tranches, with a rollback plan on every change.

04

Scale

Weekly budget reallocation across channels toward whatever is converting, reported in plain numbers.

Case studies

Where the numbers came from.

Four engagements, start to finish — the problem, what we changed, and what moved.

Nutritional Supplements · Amazon & Flipkart India

Abbott India (Ensure) — tripling New-to-Brand orders without losing Share of Voice

Challenge: Ensure's high repeat-purchase base meant only 11% of orders were New-to-Brand — the funnel was leaking at the top while competitors eyed the category.

Approach: Defended >80% brand-keyword Share of Voice while layering Amazon DSP and Flipkart display cohorts purely for NTB recruitment, timed around Amazon's Super Value Days.

29%NTB orders (from 11%)
>80%SOV maintained
Download full case study (PDF) ↓
Bed & Bath · Amazon India

InterMarket India — launching a new category from Rs. 30K to Rs. 6L/month

Challenge: Bathrobes weren't a habitual purchase in India — no brand was educating buyers, and existing listings ran on slow, trust-eroding FBM fulfilment.

Approach: Segmented the catalog into Kids/Teens/Adults, ran a two-week auto-campaign learning phase before any manual spend, then moved the top SKU to FBA and expanded regionally.

1900%Revenue growth in 4 months
2%TACoS
Download full case study (PDF) ↓
Fine Jewelry · Amazon USA

Pristine Fire — rescuing an account with 900+ broken listings

Challenge: 75% of 1,200+ SKUs were suppressed or duplicated, ads were running on listings buyers couldn't even find, and monthly orders had stalled at 42–46.

Approach: Cut the catalog to 400+ clean SKUs, rebuilt listing hygiene, A+ content, video and a Brand Store, and cut handling time from 3 days to 1 — all before reactivating any ad spend.

520%Orders growth
13%ACoS achieved
Download full case study (PDF) ↓
Bed & Bath · Amazon USA/CA/MX

Trident — pivoting from sheet sets to a category-owning towel business

Challenge: Trident was plateaued at $28K–$45K/month fighting entrenched brands in sheet sets — a category where its real strength, hospitality-grade towel manufacturing, went unused.

Approach: Re-pointed the account at a flagship 6-piece towel set, built the listing and Vine reviews before any ad spend, then moved early on Sponsored Brand Video and expanded the range globally.

3,200%Revenue growth in 11 months
$1.17MPeak month
